concert_Issue.id.justification: Both id and actionID represent unique identifiers for issues and actions respectively.

concert_Issue.id_type.justification: Both id_type and actionImpactID relate to the identification and categorization of issues and actions.

concert_Issue.last_updated_on.justification: Both last_updated_on and updateTime represent the time when an issue or action was last updated.

concert_Issue.opened_on.justification: Both opened_on and createTime represent the time when an issue or action was initiated or created.

concert_Issue.status.justification: Both status and actionState describe the current condition or state of an issue or action.

concert_IssueLink.assignees.justification: assignees and details both provide information about the individuals involved in an action or issue.

concert_IssueLink.system.justification: Both system and externalActionName relate to external identifiers or systems associated with actions or issues.
